name: task-memory
description: Durable task memory with summaries, evidence reports, archived report copies, and command-only handoffs for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Maintain and summarize task_state.md with handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Provides a skill and helper script for durable task memory across context compaction, root-owned task_state.md updates and summaries, evidence-bearing report handoffs, best-effort archived report copies, and command-only chat handoffs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $task-memory to maintain or summarize task_state.md. For summary/总结 requests, ask for compression, evidence-retention, and history-handling choices before rewriting task_state.md. Evidence-bearing handoffs create reports for root to absorb and archive; archived reports are non-authoritative audit copies, and command-only handoffs return chat-only results.
